rca_of_the_issue: Previous failure was caused by `_do_verify` applying the integrity guard only to the initial verify report. The self-heal loop then replaced failing rows with subset `verify_files()` results, which for `.md` returned linter=skip/ok=true without inspecting content. The fix extracts the guard to `_apply_integrity_guard_to_report` and reapplies it after each subset merge, so placeholder content cannot flip back to ok:true.
